# titeZMe — Design tokens / spacing / geometry / layout

Audit date: 2026-10-01 (Europe/Madrid). Existing implementation only. Source occurrences do not establish live data, runtime reachability or design intent. No production code changed.

## Styling implementation

Tailwind4.0.9 @import, global @theme brand/Titiza tokens, :root gold, defaults/arbitrary utility values, inline styles and embedded CSS coexist. No app-owned semantic spacing/radius scale beyond framework defaults found.

--spacing:0.25rem; p6=1.5rem,p8=2rem,p5=1.25rem. Inline28px/arbitrary48px bypass scale. Landing1200px/profile1000px/placeholders800px/Titiza3xl; for-shops gutters48→20px. A consistent semantic application spacing scale: **Not established / not found.**

Pills full/99px; cards xl12px/2xl16px/3xl24px/inline20px. Border1/2px/dashed/booking-left4px. Shadows/blur/opacity/stacking not centralized. Flex/column-row/grid/inline repeat-minmax/scroll shells coexist.
